div.div:
product-service (:8086)
1. Save Product/Category/Brand to PostgreSQL
2. Insert into outbox_events in SAME transaction
3. OutboxRelay polls PENDING records every 5s
4. KafkaMessagePublisher sends with key=productId

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(130, 179, 102), rgb(68, 110, 44));

div.div:
order-service (:8084)
1. Create Order / Transition Order Status
2. Writes outbox_events (order.created.v1 / order.updated.v1)
3. OrderOutboxRelay polls and publishes to Kafka
4. Key = orderId (guarantees per-order FIFO ordering)

div.div:
inventory-service (:8082)
1. Reserve / Commit / Release / Adjust Stock
2. Writes outbox_events with CloudEvents dot-case format
3. InventoryOutboxRelay sends with key=productId
4. Events: inventory.reserved.v1, committed.v1, released.v1

div.div:
payment-service (:8085)
1. Capture Stripe Payment / Process Refund
2. Writes outbox_events (payment.succeeded.v1)
3. PaymentOutboxRelay sends with key=orderId
4. Idempotency Key guarantees exactly-once processing

3. ShippingOutboxRelay sends with key=orderId

div.code:
• id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY
• event_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE
• aggregate_type VARCHAR(50) (e.g. Order, Product)
• aggregate_id VARCHAR(100)
• event_type VARCHAR(100) (e.g. order.created.v1)
• topic VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL
• payload TEXT NOT NULL (JSON)
• status VARCHAR(20) (PENDING, SENT, FAILED)
• retry_count INT DEFAULT 0
• created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
